paite: Huan, hiaite Noa tapa Sem te, Japheth te suante ahi uh: tuichim tun nungin tapate bang a nei chiat uhi.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

paite: Japheth tapate Gomer te, Magog te, Madai te, Javan te, Tubal te, Mesek te, Tiras te ahi uh.
english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

paite: Huan, Gomer tapate Askenazi te, Riphath te, Togarma te ahi uh.
english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

paite: Huan, Javan tapate Elisa te, Tarsis te leh Kittim te, Dodanim te ahi uh.
english: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

paite: Huaite akipanin ahi, Jentelte tuikulh gamtea amau gama a kikhenjak uh; amau pau bang jel leh amau nam bang jelin, amau chite lakah.
english: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

paite: Huan, Ham tapate Kus te, Mizraim te, Phut te, Kanaan te ahi uh.
english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

paite: Huan, Kus tapate Seva te, Havela te, Sabta te, Raam te, Sabtek te ahi uh: huan, Raam tapate Sheba leh Dedan ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

paite: Huan, Kusin tapa Nimrod a neia. Amah lei ah mi hattak a hong hi panta hi.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

paite: Toupa maah sabengmi hattak ahia; Huaijiakin ahi, Toupa maa sabeng hattak Nimrod bang ahi, a chih nak uh.
english: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh.”

paite: Huan, a lal kipatna Sinar gama, Babel khua te, Erek khua te, Akkad khua te, Kalneh khua te ahi.
english: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

paite: Huai gam akipanin a pawta, Assuria gamah a luta, Ninevi khua te, Rehob-Ir khua te, Kala khua te.
english: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

paite: Ninevi leh Kala kikalah Resen khua te a sata! Huai Resen khua kho thupi ahi.
english: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah (the same is the great city).

paite: Huan, Mizraimin Ludte, Anamte, Lehabte, Naphtuhte,
english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

paite: Pathruste, Kasluhte (Philistinte pawtna) te a suangta hi.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

paite: Huan, Kanaanin ta masa Zidon a neia, Heth leng a nei laia:
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

paite: Jesbuste, Amorte, Girgaste;
english: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

paite: Hivte, Arkate, Sinte;
english: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,

paite: Arvadte, Zemarte, Hamathte a suanga; huai nungin Kanaante namte a dalh jakta uhi;
english: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

paite: Huan, Kanaante gamgi zidon khua akipanin, Gerar lam juanin, Lasa khua tannin ahi.
english: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as you go toward Gerar, to Gaza; as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, to Lasha.

paite: Huaite Ham suante ahi uh, amau namte bang jel leh amau pau bang jelin amau gam lamahte lah amau chite lakah.
english: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their languages, in their lands, in their nations.

paite: Huan, Sem, Ever tate tengteng suangpa, Japheth uin leng tate a nei hi.
english: To Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth, to him also were children born.

paite: Sem tapate Elam te, Assur te, Arpaksad te, Lud te Aram te ahi uh.
english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

paite: Huan, Aram tapate Uz te, Hul te, Gether te, Mas te ahi uh.
english: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

paite: Huan, Arpaksadin tapa Selah a neia; huan, Selahin tapa Ever anei hi.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

paite: Huan, Eberin tapa nih aneia: khat min peleg ahia, a dam laiin lei lah khanin a omta ngala; a nau min Joktan ahi.
english: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

paite: Huan, Joktanin tapa Almodad te, Seleph te, Hazarmaveth te, Jerah te;
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

paite: Hadoram te, Uzal te, Diklah te;
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

paite: Obel te, Abimael te, Sheba te;
english: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

paite: Ophir te, Havel te Jobab te a neaia: huaite tengteng Joktan tapate ahi uh.
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

paite: Huan. A omna uh Mesa akipanin, suahlam tang Sephar lam juanin ahi.
english: Their dwelling was from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

paite: Huaite Sem suante ahi uh, amau namte bang jel leh amau paute bang jelin, amau gamlam teah, amau chite bang jelin.Huaite Noa suante namte ahi ua, a suante un bangjelin a chite uh lakah; tuichim tun nungin huaite akipanin ahi; leia chi chih a dalh uh.
english: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their languages, in their lands, after their nations.

paite: Huaite Noa suante namte ahi ua, a suante un bangjelin a chite uh lakah; tuichim tun nungin huaite akipanin ahi; leia chi chih a dalh uh.
english: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations. Of these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
